title: Determine Guitar Pro support for common and cut time
scope: Establish whether common/cut-time display flags have an authored representation in supported Guitar Pro versions.
acceptance: Find a valid source fixture and importer/exporter path, or document that the AlphaTab field is populated only by other formats.
Distinguish numeric 4/4 or 2/2 from an explicitly authored display symbol.
Record a scoped implementation follow-up only if a supported Guitar Pro source can express the distinction.
exclusions: Do not infer a notation symbol from a numeric meter.

reproduction.instructions: Find a valid source fixture and importer/exporter path, or document that the AlphaTab field is populated only by other formats.

evidence.detail: out-of-scope: Pinned Guitar Pro importers do not author timeSignatureCommon; model assignments come from other formats.

Record the pinned assignment search showing no GP3-GP8 importer assignment to timeSignatureCommon, with source references for the actual AlphaTex/MusicXML/other-format assignments. Update the capability scope/finding and documentation mapping to distinguish authored common/cut-time glyphs from ordinary numeric 4/4 and 2/2. Keep numeric time-signature tests intact. Resolve the investigation after the scoped exclusion and references are reviewed. Add an implementation ticket only if a real Guitar Pro fixture demonstrates a distinct authored glyph record and retaining consumer.
